CREATE TABLE `lm_signals` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `asset_class` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `symbol` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `algorithm_name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `signal_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BUY',
  `signal_strength` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `entry_price` decimal(18,8) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `target_tp_pct` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '5.00',
  `target_sl_pct` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '3.00',
  `max_hold_hours` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '24',
  `timeframe` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1h',
  `rationale` text,
  `param_source` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'original',
  `tp_original` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `sl_original` decimal(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `hold_original` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `signal_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `exit_price` decimal(18,8) DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  `pnl_pct` decimal(8,4) DEFAULT '0.0000',
  `exit_reason` varchar(30) DEFAULT '',
  `resolved_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_price` decimal(18,8) DEFAULT '0.00000000',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_asset` (`asset_class`),
  KEY `idx_symbol` (`symbol`),
  KEY `idx_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_time` (`signal_time`)
) ENGINE=MyISAM AUTO_INCREMENT=5830 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3

CREATE TABLE `ss_baselines` (

  `avg_volume_24h` decimal(20,4) DEFAULT '0.0000',
  `avg_price_change_1h` decimal(8,4) DEFAULT '0.0000',
  `avg_price_change_4h` decimal(8,4) DEFAULT '0.0000',

  `volatility_1h` decimal(8,4) DEFAULT '0.0000',
  `volatility_24h` decimal(8,4) DEFAULT '0.0000',

  UNIQUE KEY `idx_pair_class` (`pair`,`asset_class`)
